name: find the hull edge that bridges the median split, then recurse on each side
mechanism: split the points by a vertical median line, find directly (by a prune-and-search over point pairs) the single hull edge that crosses the line, discard every point under that edge, and recurse on the two sides; the work is proportional to the input times the log of the output size

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Kirkpatrick–Seidel algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry:

requires: linear-time median and a bridge-finding routine
fails_when: large constants; rarely faster in practice
